Description: Causally relation between two entities in which a behaviour brings into existence, causes to occur, destroys, prevents from occurring, or changes an entity. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Description: Has participant that relates a behaviour to the person enacting the behaviour. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1 owl:Restriction; never asserted as a direct triple.

Label: uses

Label: has behavioural companion
Description: Has participant that relates a behaviour to another sentient being that accompanies the person enacting the behaviour. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1 owl:Restriction; never asserted as a direct triple.

Label: has behavioural target
Description: Has participant that relates the behaviour to an object that the person enacting the behaviour intends to influence. Used only inside class axioms, as owl:onProperty of 1 owl:Restriction; never asserted as a direct triple.

Label: is behavioural outcome of
Description: Inverse of has behavioural outcome relation. Declared in the schema but used in no triple or class axiom.

Label: has end time

Label: occurs in
